fields.value: Pool one comparison's games across execution setups in reports

## Problem

A report shows one comparison from a single environment: `etude.page._newest_environment` keeps the cells of the environment whose latest match is newest and notes the rest, and players whose configs differ only by how they were run (manabot's `compute` block: device, dtype) are distinct players. The manabot TLA frontier (MTG-267/MTG-274) played the same comparisons in a CPU tournament (`tla-frontier-c5fba4-paired-v1`, environment `tla-frontier-c5fba4-v1`) and a CUDA one (environment `tla-frontier-c5fba4-cuda-v1`, config `compute: {device: cuda, ...}`). To read it, an operator script (`.runs/c5fba4-operator/live_report.py` in the manabot.c5fba4-frontier-self-play checkout) stripped `compute` from player configs and averaged cells game-weighted, losing intervals.

Jack Heart, 2026-11-11: "we should record how things were run but basically try go get each requested game played in any setup"; "i think of that as sort of spiritually similar to the seed".

## Outcome

Execution setup is provenance, like the seed. A report pools every game of one comparison whichever tournament, environment setup or device played it, with the interval computed by `compare` over all pooled matches, and still records (and can show) how each game was run. A tag-only `Matches` covers that tag in every tournament rather than resolving to one. Needs a way for the experiment to declare which environment/player config fields are setup (e.g. a `setup` key the page ignores for identity), rather than Etude guessing.

Consumer: `manabot.training.report` helpers (MTG-274) pass tag-only `Matches` and would pool with no manabot change.
